title: Tenant Connectivity Navigator — condensed operability panel for private clusters
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, scrollable 'Connectivity Navigator' panel that surfaces per-tenant private/VPC network health, cross-cluster link status, upgrade blockers, and cost signal overlays. The panel should fit into the Private Cluster overview (right rail) and a standalone full-width 'Connectivity Insights' page. Focus is on rapid triage (one glance can show 3-5 actionable remediation steps) and safe defaults for canary rollouts and emergency throttles.
acceptance_criteria: Component prototypes available for right-rail and full-width variants in Figma
Annotated handoff with tokenized states (ok/warn/critical/unknown) and suggested remediation actions
Accessibility pass (contrast >= 4.5:1 for status chips; keyboard tab order documented)
Engineers have component spec: data schema (flat list of links, latency percentiles, egress cost delta), API contract example, and pagination rules
PM sign-off on cost overlays and privacy-safe telemetry shown to users
decisions: Condense primary indicators to three chips (Link Health, Egress Delta, Upgrade Blockers) to reduce cognitive load
Show cost delta as percent band (green/yellow/red) rather than raw dollars to avoid noisy fluctuations
Expose 'emergency throttle' button only to users with tenant-admin role (RBAC)
Prefer optimistic defaults: show last-known value plus stale indicator if telemetry is >5m old
tradeoffs: Hiding raw egress dollars reduces noise but loses immediate billing detail for infra teams
Condensed rail sacrifices timeline depth; full-width view must provide time-series drilldown
Adding canary controls increases surface area for risk; gated behind RBAC and audit logging
review_comments: 2025-01-17 - Priya (PM): Liked condensed chips. Request: include link to related incident runbooks for critical link failures.
2025-01-21 - Arjun (Eng): Data schema request - need 95th/99th latency pctile fields and boolean 'is_stale' flag. Also prefer numeric egress in cents for downstream billing service.
2025-01-30 - Security (Anika): Ensure no tenant PII is surfaced; cost percent band OK. Security asks for KMS access pattern doc for 'emergency throttle' audit events.
2025-02-03 - Accessibility review (Rosa): Color contrast updated on v2.1, added keyboard focus ring to chips, approve pending microcopy tweaks
next_steps: PM to draft runbook links and decide which incidents map to emergency throttle (2025-02-09)
Handoff to frontend for componentization (estimate 2 sprints)
Schedule usability session with three SRE customers (week of 2025-02-10)
notes_for_engineering: Preferred data shape: flat list of {link_id, name, status, latency_95, latency_99, egress_delta_pct, last_seen_iso, region, is_stale}
UI should support streaming updates and animated state transitions for critical -> ok to avoid jarring flashes
Expose telemetry toggles server-side to reduce noise from low-volume tenants
Emergency throttle action must call audit-log endpoint and emit user id, tenant id, and throttle parameters
accessibility_considerations: Use semantic buttons for chips, provide aria-live region for status changes, provide text alternatives for color bands, ensure focus order follows visual order.
